Name: Mirren's Four Season HD Portraits
Author: ColdCurrentHALO
Description:
[code]## Description
High-resolution PNG portrait assets made for Mirren for Portraiture. Two overlay textures are included for manual setup. Sarah and rain portraits are not included. Originally this was planned as a Content Patcher pack, but I spent all night troubleshooting without success. I only figured out the PNG folder method this morning.

## Installation
1. Install SMAPI, PortraiturePlus and Portraiture.
2. Place the portrait PNGs into your Portraiture portraits folder.

## Features
- 256px HD Mirren portraits with seasonal and festival variants
- Mirren_Bruise_Overlay and Obsessive_Mirren_Eyes_Overlay for manual use

## Requirements
SMAPI, PortraiturePlus, Portraiture, Mirren the Florist NPC Mod

## Credits
Thanks to the creators of Portraiture, PortraiturePlus, SMAPI and Mirren The Florist - A Yandere (obsessive) NPC - NSFW and SFWmod.[/code]
